BEFORE YOUR FIRST CONVERSATION

Start with what
you already have.

You don’t need every document to begin. Share the broad details of your situation, and we can help identify what may be needed next.

Talk about your requirement

Helpful information to have ready

  • Company name and shareholder’s name
  • Folio number or available share records
  • Copies of certificates or dividend correspondence
  • A brief explanation of the issue or claim

Use the first conversation for basic details. We’ll discuss the appropriate way to provide sensitive documents.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Clarity before
you begin.

Can you help if I have incomplete records?+

We can begin by reviewing the details and records you have. Any further documents needed will depend on the specific holding and claim.

Can legal heirs get assistance?+

Yes. We provide documentation and coordination support for share transmission and deceased shareholder matters, based on the circumstances of the case.

How long will the process take?+

The timeline varies with the case, completeness of documents and responses from the relevant company, registrar or authority. We can discuss the expected steps after an initial review.

Is recovery guaranteed?+

No. Final eligibility, approval and processing are determined by the relevant company, registrar or authority. We help you understand and navigate the process.

How do I get started?+

Contact us by email, phone or WhatsApp with a brief summary of your shareholder matter. We’ll discuss the available information and next steps.
